title: IFSC में Financial Solicitation Professionals (FSPs) के लिए IFSCA के नए ड्राफ्ट गाइडलाइन्स!
content:
# IFSC में Financial Solicitation Professionals (FSPs) के लिए IFSCA के नए ड्राफ्ट गाइडलाइन्स!

Ek important update hai! International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) ne November 9, 2026, ko ek consultation paper issue kiya hai, jismein International Financial Services Centres (IFSCs) mein operate kar rahe Financial Institutions (FIs) dwara Financial Solicitation Professionals (FSPs) ko engage karne ke liye guidelines propose kiye gaye hain. Iska main aim financial products aur services tak wider access provide karna hai, saath hi transparency aur consumer protection ko enhance karna hai.

Yahaan kuch key points hain:

*   **Proposal ka Uddeshya:** Yeh draft guidelines financial products aur services ko logon tak pahunchane mein madad karenge, aur iske saath hi unmein adhik transparency aur suraksha layenge.
*   **FSPs ka Role:** FSPs aise individuals honge jo FIs ke behalf par clients ko solicit karenge ya financial services tak unki pahunch ko facilitate karenge.
*   **FIs ki Zimmedari:** Proposed framework ke तहत, FIs ko FSPs engage karne se pehle proper due diligence karni hogi aur unke acts and omissions ke liye responsible rahenge. FIs ko apni website par engaged FSPs ki list publish aur regularly update karni hogi taaki transparency bani rahe.
*   **FSPs ke Niyam:** FSPs ko apni affiliated FI ko identify karna hoga, accurate information deni hogi, aur misleading representations ya assured returns dene se bachna hoga. Unhein client assets hold nahi karne aur client confidentiality maintain karni hogi.
*   **Comments ki Deadline:** Stakeholders ko in draft guidelines par apne comments November 30, 2026, tak submit karne ke liye invite kiya gaya hai.
